description: As a prosecutor with the Cumberland County District Attorney’s Office, I primarily handled domestic violence matters. During this time, I had the opportunity to work with many brave survivors of domestic violence.  This is the main lesson I learned: Simply put, I learned how to listen. I

title: Lesson Learned as a Domestic Violence Prosecutor — Charles R. Smith for North Carolina House of Representatives District 44
